2. Heard Mr. S.N. Goswami, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner and perused the petition and the orders including the order sheet in that particular case wherefrom it appears that the learned judge as a matter of fact did not dispose of the application, filed before him on merit. Although the petitioner had claimed to have paid some amount out of the decreetal 

 Second Court, Bagerhat to dispose of the application under section 152 of the Code of Civil Procedure read with section 57 of the Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 filed by the petitioner on 18.6.2005 on merit giving a chance to the decree holder to convert the same if he is so advised, within 4(four) weeks from the date of receipt of this order.
